_doc: Arena 6 (retail world 36: a floating meadow, ruins and scaffolds) kit for the map editor (S36), same schema as art/arena5/kit.json. Pieces the arena also uses from the arena 1, 2 and 5 kits are listed in shared. on: block = stacked on top of another block (y = 0 is where it rests on it). kind cliff = hangs under an edge cell of the island in place of its block: origin = the cell centre at the block's top (the cap lies on it), the rock goes down from there; +x and +z are the faces seen.

pieces.name: ashlar_block
pieces.label: Bloque de sillares con musgo
pieces.note: 0.78 m tall; set in rows as the ruined walls; the mossy cap (1472) stacks on it

pieces.name: rubble_heap
pieces.label: Montón de piedras apiladas
pieces.note: about 0.6 m; at the foot of walls and pillars, also alone on the grass

pieces.name: mossy_cap
pieces.label: Remate de piedras con musgo y flores
pieces.note: stacked on the ashlar block (1381): y = 0 rests on its top

pieces.name: cliff_col
pieces.label: Columna del acantilado
pieces.note: about 2.75 m under the block top

pieces.name: cliff_col_knobs
pieces.label: Columna del acantilado con bolos
pieces.note: the boulders are on its +z face

pieces.name: cliff_tip
pieces.label: Punta del acantilado (esquina delantera)
pieces.note: the island's lowest point, about 3.3 m; its spine is on the +x+z corner

pieces.name: cliff_slant
pieces.label: Placa del acantilado (cara)
pieces.note: a plate on the column's +x face, longest at its +z end

pieces.name: cliff_shard
pieces.label: Placa estrecha del acantilado
pieces.note: half a cell wide, on the +z face, to break a long run of columns
